variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: The company {company} has laid off many workers. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.body: Many workers have been laid off by {company}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
